apps.localizedDescription: Eagle is an experimental iOS personalization toolbox powered by DarkSword. This beta has been tested primarily on iPhone 16 Pro running iOS 18.6.2 (22G100). Compatibility with other devices and releases is not guaranteed. Back up important data and try one feature at a time.

versions.localizedDescription: First Eagle public beta. Includes Styles, Wallpapers, Cards, Passcode, Icon Studio, Dock, Island Aura and Eagle System. The IPA is unsigned and experimental.
